jobs.title: Onboarding Project Manager
jobs.description:
What Makes Cloudbeds Unique

At Cloudbeds, we're not just building software, we’re transforming hospitality. Our intelligently designed platform powers properties across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From independent properties to hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've become the World's Best Hotel PMS Solutions Provider and landed on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again in 2024, but we're just getting started. 

How You'll Make an Impact:

As an Onboarding Project Manager

, you will lead complex onboarding projects for Cloudbeds’ mid-market customers, guiding them from contract signature through adoption and successful transition to Account Management at the time onboarding is completed. Acting as the strategic lead throughout the onboarding journey, you will partner cross-functionally with Onboarding, Account Management, Sales, Product, Support, Professional Services teams to deliver a seamless implementation experience that drives customer confidence, platform adoption, and measurable business outcomes.
You will play a critical role in ensuring customers realize value quickly by managing timelines, aligning stakeholders, mitigating risks, and maintaining a high-touch customer experience. This role combines project management, customer partnership and relationship management, operational excellence, and hospitality expertise in a fast-paced SaaS environment. You may be required to travel onsite within Thailand during the onboarding period when necessary to ensure the best possible customer experience and a clear understanding of the customer’s setup and desired outcomes
Our Onboarding Project Management Team:

Our team is passionate about delivering exceptional customer experiences and helping hoteliers succeed with Cloudbeds from day one. We build together, review opportunities together, and embrace a test-and-learn mindset that encourages innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Every team member is valued and empowered to share feedback, ideas, and insights so we can learn, grow, and improve both as individuals and as a team. Team members who thrive here are proactive communicators, collaborative problem-solvers, and true customer advocates who enjoy navigating complexity while working closely with others to drive successful outcomes.
What You Bring to the Team:

Own and manage the end-to-end onboarding lifecycle for mid-market customers, from sales handoff through go-live, adoption, and transition to Account Management
Define project scope, timelines, milestones, and deliverables to ensure successful and timely implementations
Serve as the primary point of contact for onboarding mid market customers, driving clear communication and stakeholder alignment throughout the project lifecycle
Lead customer meetings including pre-kickoff, kickoff, project check ins, and go-live milestones while documenting action items and next steps
Proactively identify and manage risks, dependencies, and escalation points to maintain project momentum and customer satisfaction
Coordinate cross-functional collaboration across Sales, Onboarding, Product, Support, Professional Services, and Account Management teams
Monitor onboarding success metrics, customer adoption, training completion, and utilization milestones to support long-term customer success

What Sets You Up for Success:

Fluency in Thai, and English at a business-professional level, both written and spoken
Minimum 4 years of experience in hotel operations or hotel management
At least 2 year of project management experience within a SaaS or customer-facing environment
Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining strong attention to detail and organization
Experience coordinating cross-functional stakeholders and driving projects through completion in a fast-paced environment
Strong communication, relationship management, and customer-facing presentation skills
Ability to proactively solve problems, manage ambiguity, and adapt quickly to changing customer and business needs

Bonus Skills to Stand Out (Optional):

At least 2 year of project management experience within a hospitality SaaS environment
Previous experience with customer implementation & onboarding at a hospitality SAAS company
Familiarity with Salesforce, Zendesk, Slack, or other customer operations tools

What to Expect - Your Journey with Us

Behind Cloudbeds' revolutionary technology is a team of redefining what's possible in hospitality. We're 650+ employees across 40+ countries, bringing together elite engineers, AI architects, world-class designers, and hospitality veterans to solve challenges others haven't dared to tackle. Our diverse team speaks 30+ languages, but we all share one language: a passion for innovation and travel. From pioneering breakthroughs in machine learning to revolutionizing how hotels operate, we're not just watching the future of hospitality unfold – we're coding it, designing it, writing it, and shipping it. If you're ready to work alongside some of the brightest minds in tech who are obsessed with using AI to transform a trillion-dollar industry, this is your chance to be part of something extraordinary.
Learn more online at cloudbeds.com 
Company Awards:

Best All-In-One Hotel Management System | HotelTechAwards (2025)
Overall 10 Best Places to Work | HotelTechAwards (2025)
Most Loved Workplace® Certified (2024)
Top 10 People’s Choice (2024)
Deloitte Technology Fast 500 (2024)

Discover our Benefits:

Remote First, Remote Always
PTO in accordance with local labor requirements
Monthly Wellness Fridays - enjoy an extra-long weekend every month
Fully Paid Parental Leave
Home office stipend based on country of residency
Professional development courses in Cloudbeds University
Access to professional development, including manager training, upskilling and knowledge transfer 

Everyone is Welcome - A Culture of Inclusion

Cloudbeds is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer that celebrates the diversity in our global team! We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.
Cloudbeds is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, Cloudbeds will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations in the hiring process. We encourage deaf, hard-of-hearing, deaf-blind, and deaf-disabled individuals to apply. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process or to perform essential job functions, please contact our HR team by phone at (858) 201-7832 or via email at accommodations@cloudbeds.com. Cloudbeds will provide an American Sign Language (ASL) interpreter where needed as a reasonable accommodation for the hiring processes.
To all Staffing and Recruiting Agencies: Our Careers Site is only for individuals seeking a job at Cloudbeds. Staffing, recruiting agencies, and individuals being represented by an agency are not authorized to use this site or to submit applications, and any such submissions will be considered unsolicited. Cloudbeds does not accept unsolicited resumes or applications from agencies. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, Cloudbeds employees, or any other company location. Cloudbeds is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes/applications.

A high-growth, venture-backed SaaS company is building its founding India team and has partnered with Flexiple to hire. This is an early-career role with real ownership, where you will learn delivery hands-on alongside experienced project leaders. Flexiple is a managed marketplace that helps global companies build high-performing teams and GCCs in India.

As an Assistant Project Manager, you will support project planning and delivery, keep trackers and timelines current, and help teams stay coordinated and on schedule.

Clear written and spoken English and a reliable remote-work setup

An internship or project exposure in a startup or tech team
Awareness of Agile or Scrum ways of working
A degree in business, engineering, or a related field

An early-career delivery seat with a high-growth SaaS company

jobs.title: Project Manager EMEA
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Project Manager EMEA based in Ireland.

As a Project Manager EMEA, you will lead complex client projects across a fast-growing global business messaging environment.

You will own enterprise client onboarding from initial setup through technical integration and campaign execution.

The role combines project management, stakeholder coordination, technical problem-solving, and customer relationship management.

You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Support teams to keep projects moving and resolve issues efficiently.

Your work will directly contribute to successful customer launches, reliable messaging campaigns, and scalable operational processes.

This is an opportunity to influence how businesses adopt messaging technology while working with international clients and distributed teams.

The position is fully remote and suited to an organized, independent professional who thrives in a fast-paced and evolving environment.

Accountabilities

Lead enterprise client onboarding end-to-end, including WhatsApp Business Account setup, phone number registration, template approvals, and technical integrations with APIs and CRM platforms such as Salesforce.
Plan, coordinate, and manage WhatsApp campaign sendouts, including template classification, scheduling, monitoring, and delivery troubleshooting.
Serve as the primary project contact for a portfolio of enterprise clients, leading status meetings, coordinating expectations, and managing escalations.
Coordinate cross-functional activities with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Support teams to resolve technical and operational issues and maintain project momentum.
Manage multiple concurrent projects and clients, balancing competing priorities, deadlines, and stakeholder requirements.
Maintain accurate project documentation, timelines, milestones, status updates, and performance tracking.
Define, monitor, and communicate relevant project KPIs, timelines, risks, and progress.
Identify process gaps and opportunities for improvement, contributing to scalable onboarding and campaign execution playbooks.
Proactively identify risks and blockers and take ownership of resolving issues or securing the appropriate internal support.
Build efficient, repeatable processes that improve the customer experience and support the organization’s continued growth.

Requirements

3+ years of project management experience, ideally within SaaS, martech, B2B technology, or another fast-paced digital environment.
Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent projects or enterprise clients while handling competing priorities and deadlines.
Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to align internal teams and external clients around objectives, timelines, and deliverables.
Solid understanding of project management methodologies, including Agile/Scrum, Waterfall, or hybrid approaches.
Comfortable working with project management and tracking tools and maintaining structured project documentation.
Data-driven mindset with the ability to define, monitor, analyze, and report on project KPIs and timelines.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; additional languages such as Russian, Spanish, or Portuguese are an advantage.
Familiarity with the WhatsApp Business API, Meta Business ecosystem, messaging platforms, or CRM technologies is a plus.
Understanding of B2B client onboarding, technical integrations, campaign implementation, or marketing funnel processes is advantageous.
Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage several workstreams independently.
Practical problem-solving approach with a strong bias toward action and ownership.
Comfortable working autonomously in a fast-paced, continuously evolving product and technology environment.
Demonstrated willingness to learn, share knowledge, take responsibility, and contribute to the development of scalable processes and solutions.

Benefits

€3,000–€3,500 per month, depending on experience, seniority, and fit with the role requirements.
Fully remote, contract-based position with the flexibility to work from anywhere in the world.
Opportunity to work in a global, technology-driven environment focused on the rapidly evolving business messaging industry.
Collaboration with experienced technology and business professionals across an international, distributed organization.
Significant opportunities for professional growth, learning, and exposure to SaaS, messaging technology, enterprise client management, and technical project delivery.
Opportunity to take ownership of impactful projects and contribute ideas to improve products, processes, and customer experiences.
Dynamic environment that encourages independent thinking, continuous learning, responsibility, and scalable solutions.
Competitive compensation designed to reflect skills, experience, and achievements.

How Jobgether Works

We use an AI-powered matching process
to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Why Apply Through Jobgether?

Data Privacy Notice:
By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Content Solution Project Manager
jobs.description:
Role Overview

The Content Solutions Project Manager is responsible for leading strategic content initiatives that support Dayforce’s knowledge ecosystem across customer, partner, and employee audiences. This role manages the delivery of complex content programs, ensuring that content assets, processes, systems, and governance frameworks are aligned with business goals and user needs.

Working closely with Product, Services, Customer Support, Learning, and Knowledge Management teams, the Content Solutions Project Manager drives end-to-end execution of content projects, from planning and stakeholder alignment through implementation, measurement, and optimization. The successful candidate combines strong project management expertise with a deep understanding of content operations, knowledge management, content technologies, analytics, and AI-enabled content solutions.

What You'll Get to Do

Project Leadership & Delivery

Lead multiple concurrent content initiatives and strategic programs, ensuring successful delivery within scope, schedule, and quality expectations.
Develop and maintain project plans, timelines, dependencies, milestones, and status reporting for content-focused initiatives.
Identify and manage project risks, issues, assumptions, and dependencies while proactively driving mitigation strategies.
Establish governance frameworks and communication plans to keep stakeholders informed and aligned throughout project lifecycles.
Facilitate project meetings, working sessions, retrospectives, and executive-level status reviews.
Coordinate resources across a matrix organization to ensure successful delivery of content and knowledge management initiatives.
Drive organizational readiness and change management activities related to content processes, systems, and technologies.

Content Operations & Strategy

Partner with Content Solutions leadership to execute content strategies that improve discoverability, usability, quality, and customer experience.
Lead initiatives involving content migration, content lifecycle management, content governance, AI-enabled content programs, and knowledge platform enhancements.
Ensure content programs align with established taxonomy, metadata, structured authoring, accessibility, and governance standards.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives that streamline content creation, review, publication, and maintenance workflows.
Identify opportunities to leverage AI, automation, analytics, and emerging technologies to improve content operations and scale knowledge delivery.

Stakeholder Management & Collaboration

Build strong partnerships with Services, Support, Learning, and Subject Matter Experts.
Facilitate requirements gathering and consensus-building across diverse stakeholder groups.
Manage stakeholder expectations regarding scope, priorities, timelines, deliverables, and resource commitments.
Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned content initiatives and strategic projects.
Champion a knowledge-sharing culture and foster collaboration across global teams.

Measurement & Continuous Improvement

Define success metrics and measure project outcomes using content analytics, adoption metrics, user feedback, and business KPIs.
Monitor content performance trends and identify opportunities for optimization.
Develop executive-ready reports and dashboards communicating project status, outcomes, and value realization.
Contribute to the evolution of content governance, project management methodologies, tools, templates, and best practices.
Support the development of scalable operating models that enable content teams to deliver efficiently and consistently.

Skills and Experience We Value

Education & Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Communications, Knowledge Management, Information Design, Technical Communication, Project Management, or a related field.
2-5 years of experience in project management, program management, knowledge management, content operations, technical communications, or related disciplines.
Experience leading cross-functional projects in SaaS, enterprise software, or technology environments.
PMP, CAPM, Agile, Scrum, or equivalent project management certification preferred.

Technical & Functional Expertise

Experience managing content development, content operations, knowledge management, or digital transformation initiatives.
Strong understanding of content lifecycle management, content governance, taxonomy, metadata, and structured authoring principles.
Experience with content management systems, knowledge management platforms, and content publishing workflows.
Experience leveraging analytics, reporting, and AI technologies to improve content effectiveness and operational efficiency.
Proficiency with project management tools such as Smartsheet, Jira, Azure DevOps, Microsoft Project, or similar platforms.
Experience with process improvement, workflow optimization, and change management methodologies.

Professional Skills

Exceptional organizational and planning skills with the ability to manage multiple complex initiatives simultaneously.
Strong stakeholder management, relationship-building, and influencing skills.
Excellent communication, presentation, facilitation, and negotiation abilities.
Ability to translate business objectives into actionable project plans and measurable outcomes.
Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving and decision-making capabilities.
Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams in a matrix environment.

What Would Make You Stand Out

Experience managing enterprise knowledge management or customer experience initiatives.
Experience implementing AI-driven content, search, or knowledge solutions.
Familiarity with Dayforce products and the HCM industry.
Experience supporting global content operations across multiple languages and regions.
Experience leading content migrations, CMS implementations, or knowledge platform transformations.
Demonstrated success establishing governance models and operational frameworks that improve content quality and efficiency.
Passion for innovation, content technology, and delivering exceptional knowledge experiences.

jobs.title: Assistant Project Manager
jobs.description:
ASC is Australia’s submarine company. We built the Royal Australian Navy’s Collins Class submarines, sustain them, and are now delivering their Life of Type Extension to increase the boats’ service lives. We have also been selected by the Australian Government to sustain and jointly build the nation’s nuclear-powered submarines - the largest and most complex industrial undertaking in Australia’s history.
Our work is interesting and meaningful, contributing directly to Australia’s national security. We offer rewarding roles that provide the opportunity to grow your career, and the flexibility to balance life and work. A career at ASC is like no other, delivering a deeper purpose we can all be proud of.

About the Opportunity

We’re looking for a dynamic Assistant Project Manager to support the planning, execution, and reporting of our diverse project portfolio in the Innovation, Science & Technology Program. Working closely with the Innovation, Science & Technology Project Manager and a collaborative team, you’ll play a key role in shaping the future of innovation across the organisation.
Responsibilities

Support the delivery of innovation, science and technology initiatives from concept through to implementation and handover.

Assist in the development of project plans, roadmaps and business cases that support emerging technologies and strategic innovation priorities.

Monitor project progress, schedules, budgets, risks and outcomes to ensure successful delivery and value for investment.

Evaluate innovation opportunities and support feasibility assessments, business case development and project prioritisation activities.

Build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders across the business, industry, academia and government.

Prepare project reports, presentations and governance documentation to support effective decision-making.

Contribute to project governance, frameworks and continuous improvement initiatives that enhance project delivery and innovation capability.

Support portfolio management activities, ensuring projects remain aligned with business objectives and strategic priorities.

Provide day-to-day project coordination and support to the broader Innovation & Improvement team.

Tertiary qualifications in Project Management, Engineering, Business or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.

jobs.title: Project Manager - Logistics, Process Optimization & AI Automation
jobs.description:
About the Role

Delticom is looking for a Project Manager - Logistics, Process Optimization & AI Automation to support the continuous improvement and digitalisation of our European e-commerce operations.
The role sits at the intersection of logistics, supply chain, business processes and AI-enabled automation.
You will work closely with Operations, Logistics, Purchasing, IT and other business functions to analyse existing processes, identify improvement opportunities and manage projects from initial concept through implementation.
A particular focus of the role is the practical use of AI and automation. We are looking for someone who understands operational processes and is comfortable using modern AI tools to improve workflows, reporting, decision-making and efficiency.
This is a hands-on project-management role. You do not need to be a software developer or a senior supply-chain executive. You should, however, understand logistics and operational processes well enough to identify problems, structure solutions and work with technical teams to implement them.

Your Responsibilities

Manage operational improvement and digitalisation projects across logistics, warehousing, transport, supply chain, purchasing and related business processes.
Analyse existing workflows and identify bottlenecks, manual activities and opportunities for optimisation.
Work with operational teams to define requirements and translate them into clear project plans and implementation steps.
Coordinate projects involving internal departments, logistics providers, suppliers and technology partners.
Support the optimisation of warehousing and fulfilment, transportation and carrier management, inventory and product availability, purchasing and supplier processes, demand and capacity planning, and operational reporting and KPI management.
Identify opportunities to use AI, automation and data-driven tools to reduce manual work and improve operational performance.
Prototype and test AI-assisted workflows using LLMs, AI agents, automation platforms and APIs.
Work with IT, developers and external partners to move successful prototypes into reliable business processes.
Create process documentation, business requirements, SOPs, workflows and project documentation.
Monitor project progress, risks, timelines and dependencies.
Define KPIs and measure the operational impact of implemented improvements.
Support management with analyses, reporting and recommendations.
Participate in cross-functional and international projects across Delticom's European operations.

What We Are Looking For

Approximately 2-4 years of professional experience in project management, logistics, supply chain, operations, process management, e-commerce or a comparable field.
Practical understanding of logistics and operational processes.
Experience managing improvement, digitalisation or automation projects.
Experience working with warehouses, transportation, inventory, purchasing, suppliers or fulfilment processes is highly desirable.
Experience in e-commerce, online retail or another order-to-delivery environment is a strong advantage.
Ability to analyse processes, identify problems and structure practical solutions.
Strong project-management and stakeholder-management skills.
Comfortable working with operational and technical teams.
Good understanding of KPIs, process performance and operational reporting.
Hands-on interest in AI and automation.
Experience using modern AI tools such as Zed, Cursor, ChatGPT, Claude, or similar solutions.
Ability to understand APIs, workflows, integrations and technical documentation at a functional level.
Good analytical skills and confidence working with data.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Professional English. German is highly desirable.
Willingness to work on-site in Hannover.

AI & Automation Experience

You do not need to be an AI engineer. We are looking for someone who is comfortable experimenting with technology and can use AI to solve practical operational problems.
Relevant experience could include:
LLMs and generative AI; prompt engineering; AI agents and AI-assisted workflows.
Power Automate, n8n, Make, UiPath or similar automation platforms.
Process mining, Python, SQL, REST APIs or webhooks.
Power BI or similar analytics tools.
ERP, WMS or TMS systems and low-code/no-code platforms.
AI-assisted coding tools such as Zed, Cursor, or similar.

Experience with every technology listed above is not required. What matters is the ability to learn quickly and apply technology to real operational problems.
Your Profile
You enjoy understanding how processes actually work.
When you see a repetitive manual task, an inefficient handover or an operational bottleneck, your first reaction is to understand the root cause and look for a better solution.
You are comfortable speaking with warehouse, logistics, purchasing and business teams, but you can also work effectively with IT, developers and technology providers.
You do not simply create PowerPoint recommendations. You like taking responsibility for implementation, testing whether a solution works, and improving it based on real-world results.
You are curious about AI and already use modern AI tools in your work. At the same time, you understand that technology is only valuable when it solves a genuine business problem.
Particularly Relevant Backgrounds

We would be especially interested in candidates with experience in:

e-commerce or online retail;
logistics or fulfilment companies;
automotive or spare-parts distribution;
retail supply chains;
3PL or transportation organisations;
supply-chain consulting;
operational excellence or process improvement;
ERP/WMS/TMS implementation;
digitalisation or automation projects.

Experience in the tyre or automotive sector is helpful, but not required.
What Success Looks Like

Within your first year, we would expect you to have:

successfully delivered several operational improvement projects;
automated selected manual processes;
improved transparency through better KPIs and reporting;
identified and implemented practical AI use cases;
reduced unnecessary operational effort or process complexity;
improved collaboration between Operations and IT;
developed a strong understanding of Delticom's European logistics and supply-chain processes; and
created measurable improvements in cost, speed, quality or reliability.

If you have experience in logistics or operational processes, enjoy managing implementation projects and want to apply AI and automation to real business challenges, we would like to hear from you.

Current UC employees must apply internally via SuccessFactors Next Lives at the University of Cincinnati Founded in 1819, the University of Cincinnati ranks among the nation’s best urban public research universities. Home to more than 53,600 students, 12,000 faculty and staff, and over 360,000 living alumni, UC, a Carnegie 1 institution, combines research prowess with a physical setting The New York Times has called “the most ambitious campus design program in the country." UC's momentum has never been stronger as the anchor of the Cincinnati Innovation District, the oldest cooperative education (co-op) program in the country with students earning $94 million annually through paid experiences, an academic health system, and as a member of the Big 12 Conference. The university contributes $10.6 billion in economic impact to the city and $22.7 billion to the state of Ohio. At UC, next is all of us. Learn more at uc.edu. UC is a mission-driven organization where we are committed to student success and positively transforming the community through scholarship and service. We thrive on innovation, making an impact, and fostering an environment where staff and faculty are key contributors to UC’s success. Job Overview

Under the direction of the Director of Career Services, the Program Manager supports the daily operations and strategic initiatives of UC Clermont's Career Services Center. This position coordinates career programming, employer engagement activities, workforce development initiatives, communications, events, and operational functions that advance the college's commitment to career readiness and experiential learning.

Serving as a central connector between students, faculty, staff, employers, alumni, and community partners, the Program Manager helps students discover opportunities, access campus and community resources, engage in experiential learning, and prepare for meaningful careers. Working collaboratively across the college, this position builds relationships, supports employer partnerships, coordinates departmental operations, and enhances student engagement through high-quality programs, services, and outreach. Work collaboratively with faculty, staff, campus partners, employers, alumni, and the Career Services team to coordinate programs, connect students with opportunities, and deliver high-quality services.
Maintain confidentiality of student records and other sensitive information in accordance with university policies and applicable regulations.

Employer & Community Engagement

Data, Assessment & Reporting

Mass General Brigham relies on a wide range of professionals, including doctors, nurses, business people, tech experts, researchers, and systems analysts to advance our mission. Summary

Job Summary

The Research Data Analyst will work under the direction of the Principal Investigator to support collaborative research integrating genomic and multi-omic data with clinical and electronic health record (EHR) data. The analyst will contribute to projects investigating the genetic, epigenetic, and downstream molecular basis of psychiatric and related complex traits.

Does this position require Patient Care?

No

Essential Functions

Perform statistical analyses of genomic and molecular data, including polygenic risk score (PRS) analyses and association testing.
Integrate genetic, transcriptomic, methylomic, clinical, and EHR phenotype data to investigate relationships between molecular variation and clinical outcomes.
Analyze high-dimensional transcriptomic and DNA methylation datasets.
Train genetically regulated gene expression (GReX) models and conduct transcriptome-wide association studies (TWAS).

Yes

Experience attained through education or 0–1 year of relevant research or data-analysis experience required. Academic research, internships, or coursework involving statistical analysis or biomedical data may satisfy this requirement.

Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

Proficiency in R and statistical data analysis; experience with Python is desirable.
Experience working with large, complex, or high-dimensional biomedical datasets.
Familiarity with genomic, transcriptomic, DNA methylation, or other molecular data.

jobs.title: Justice System Program Manager, Bangladesh
jobs.description:
Who We Are

International Justice Mission (IJM) is a global leader in protecting vulnerable people from violence around the world. Our team of over 1,200 professionals are at work worldwide in over 30 offices. Together we are on a mission to rescue millions, protect half a billion, and make justice unstoppable.

We are a global community that cares for one another. We believe that the way we work is as important as the results we achieve. We provide professional excellence with joy and celebration to all those we serve.

The Need

For over 25 years, IJM has pioneered the work to protect vulnerable people from violence. 9 out of 9 times in the last decade, IJM’s Justice System Strengthening Projects have reduced slavery and violence between 50 and 85% for very large populations of people in poverty. As we grow to expand our impact to protect 500 million people from violence, we are seeking a Justice System Program Manager, who will provide guidance to all the casework team from Bangladesh (Dhaka, Khulna, Mymensingh and Barishal division) and develop strategies to ensure effective and timely prosecution of IJMs cases, strengthen partnerships with the key legal stakeholders to bring the cases through to conviction. The position will report to the Director, Justice System Program.

This role leads the development and implementation of strategic legal interventions to strengthen the response of first responders and justice sector stakeholders in addressing Commercial Sexual Exploitation of Children (CSEC) and advancing IJM’s 2030 goals. The position provides training, technical guidance, and best practices to improve justice system outcomes, while working closely with the Regional Justice Solutions Team, Divisional Directors, casework teams, and partner organizations. The role also supports capacity building, legal strategy implementation, and stakeholder engagement, and requires regular field and court visits with extensive travel across district and divisional levels.

The role is based in Dhaka, but will provide support nationally, including travelling to each of IJM’s future program locations (Khulna, Barisal and Mymensingh).

Responsibilities:

Strategy, Knowledge Development, & Implementation:

Lead and support the design and implementation of legal strategies within justice system transformation projects.
Represent the legal function in project planning, coordination, and strategic initiatives.
Develop legal tools, best practices, and innovative approaches to strengthen case outcomes and victim protection.
Mentor advocates and provide legal compliance guidance to internal teams and partners.
Strengthen the capacity of the criminal justice system to address trafficking and CSEC cases.
Ensure alignment of IJM global legal standards with Bangladesh’s legal framework and legal practices.
Support implementation of IJM’s Protection Model and effective legal interventions.
Provide technical legal expertise, casework support, and strategic guidance to legal teams and partners.
Promote and scale effective legal models, tools, and frameworks across programs.
Support the adoption of global and regional legal standards, resources, and best practices.

Networking & Partnership:

Build and maintain strategic partnerships with legal, judicial, and government stakeholders to strengthen anti-trafficking and CSEC responses.
Develop legal tools, resources, and training materials to support internal teams and external partners.
Represent IJM at legal forums, conferences, and key stakeholder engagements.
Promote the adoption of legal best practices and strengthen partner capacity.
Analyze case and program data to inform reporting and improve justice system outcomes.
Facilitate partnerships and MoUs with academic, judicial, and strategic institutions to advance child protection and anti-trafficking efforts.

Communication:

Development of briefs, papers, fact sheets, and other communication resources as necessary; that articulates IJM’s approach and strategy for Legal casework.
Consistently communicate with IJM legal teams and field leaders about the trends and changes on the legal aspects of human trafficking and protection model across the regions.
Conduct periodical meetings with the National and Divisional legal team to identify the needs, provide feedback on case development, legal strategies, team management, and policy compliances.
Conduct regular meetings with national and specialists to identify the requirements to enhance the capacity of the legal team to achieve IJM’s 2030 vision.
Connect with the National and Divisional Program Directors to give and receive feedback on legal team performance.
Communicate legal Field priorities to the Director, Justice System Program and work towards the alignment on IJM’s 2030 vision strategy.

Policies & Procedures:

Collaborate with the National, South Asia Leadership team and the Divisional Legal team to facilitate the development of comprehensive Legal policies, procedures and best practices.
Provide legal expertise and strategic inputs into various aspects, such as procedures, research, curriculum, contracts, or MOUs, resulting in rigorous and legally sound research, drafting, and decision making.
Collect regional best practices/learnings for Legal casework and support.

Training and Development:

Develop and deliver legal training modules for IJM staff and legal teams on best practices and legal interventions.
Build the capacity of divisional legal staff to support IJM’s 2030 vision.
Facilitate training, coaching, and mentoring on human trafficking and CSEC investigations.
Adapt global legal tools and training materials to the Bangladesh context.
Support capacity building within the criminal justice system and contribute to the development of IJM training resources.
Develop legal tools, resources, and training materials for internal and external stakeholders.
Conduct in-person training sessions for staff, partners, and other stakeholders as required.

Research, Program Management, and M&E:

Engage in research projects as needed to provide legal expertise.
Provide knowledge and advisory services on legal procedures to Partners and CSOs.
Oversee the research on various legal matters as needed and provide recommendations to the policies, manuals, and procedures.
Monitor that Legal activities (internal & with partners) are being implemented well.

Documentation, Reporting & Data Management:

Monitor Legal Data Collection and Analysis.
Ensure that all copies of letters and documents submitted to the judiciary are stored in the data center on a regular basis.
Bring relevant issues/needs to the attention of Director of Justice System Program.
To be efficient and expert in handling JDS and other technical tools of IJM.
Excellent in drafting letters and legal correspondence.
Expert in matters pertaining to court and legal issues.

Casework:

Mentor and support IJM lawyers and justice officials to build strong cases and promote justice for trafficking survivors.
Prepare and support survivors through legal proceedings using a trauma-informed approach.
Implement IJM’s protection model throughout legal processes and court proceedings.
Coordinate with government agencies, partners, and internal teams to ensure survivor safety and security.
Work with investigators to collect and preserve admissible evidence in trafficking and child exploitation cases.
Collaborate with Aftercare Specialists to address survivors' psychosocial needs.
Support the hosting of guests, visitors, and volunteers as needed.

Qualifications

Education & Experience:

Bachelor’s degree in law (LL.B.) required; Master’s degree (LL.M.) preferred.
Strong knowledge of Bangladesh criminal, anti-trafficking, and child protection laws.
7+ years of legal experience in criminal litigation, trial advocacy, or corporate legal practice.
4+ years of leadership experience, preferably managing legal teams or advocates.
Excellent legal research, drafting, and advocacy skills.
Experience in project design and implementation.
Demonstrated commitment to human rights and social justice.

Technical Competencies:

Support IJM advocates (full-time and contractual) and assists public prosecutors in CSEC and Trafficking case hearings, including bail, pre-trial, trial, and appeal proceedings.
Guide advocates in achieving deterrence through arrests, restraints, bail cancellations, and convictions.
Demonstrate strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex legal concepts.
Conduct training and capacity-building initiatives.
Manage budgets and resources effectively.
Provide leadership, coaching, mentoring, and team development support.
Apply international and cross-cultural legal experience in diverse environments.
Proficient in Microsoft Office applications.
Provide field-based support and capacity building to partners to strengthen State and District team effectiveness.

Non-Technical Competencies:

Strong multicultural awareness and ability to work effectively across diverse environments
Committed to IJM’s mission, values, and professionalism.
Humble servant leader with integrity and ethical conduct.
Innovative, courageous, and solutions-oriented.
Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage priorities effectively.
Able to perform under pressure while maintaining professionalism.
Collaborative, adaptable, and service-minded team player.

Application Process:

jobs.title: Data Analyst (Business Insights & AI) - The Coffee House
jobs.description:
Mô tả công việc

Mô Tả Công Việc

Phân tích hiệu quả kinh doanh & Strategic Business Insights
Theo dõi và phân tích hiệu quả kinh doanh theo cửa hàng, khu vực, kênh, khung giờ, nhóm sản phẩm, phân khúc khách hàng và chiến dịch; chủ động phát hiện biến động bất thường, cơ hội tăng trưởng và rủi ro.
Kết nối nhiều nguồn dữ liệu như POS, App/Web, nền tảng giao hàng, CRM/Loyalty, Finance và nghiên cứu thị trường để tạo góc nhìn toàn diện thay vì phân tích từng nguồn riêng lẻ.
Phân rã chênh lệch so với kế hoạch, kỳ trước và baseline; xác định nguyên nhân gốc và lượng hóa tác động của từng driver đến doanh thu, transaction, ticket size, traffic, margin và customer metrics.
Khai thác AI để tăng tốc anomaly detection, hypothesis generation, root-cause analysis và scenario exploration; luôn đối chiếu lại bằng dữ liệu gốc, business logic và phương pháp phân tích độc lập.
Đánh giá các yếu tố Customer/Member, Consumer, Company, Competition và Market Context; chuyển kết quả phân tích thành storyline, khuyến nghị, trade-off và tác động kỳ vọng để hỗ trợ lãnh đạo ra quyết định.
Chủ động đưa ra quan điểm độc lập, dựa trên bằng chứng và sẵn sàng challenge giả định kinh doanh khi dữ liệu cho thấy hướng đi khác.
Customer, Channel, Product & Market Analytics
Phân tích hành vi và vòng đời khách hàng thông qua segmentation, RFM/cohort, acquisition, activation, conversion, frequency, retention, churn và customer lifetime value.
Phân tích funnel App/Web và hành trình omni-channel để xác định điểm rơi chuyển đổi, rào cản trải nghiệm, dịch chuyển kênh và cơ hội tăng tần suất mua.
Đánh giá hiệu quả danh mục và sản phẩm theo vai trò hero/traffic/trial/AOV; phân tích pricing, promotion depth, attach rate, basket mix, margin, cannibalization và hiệu quả combo.
Phân tích hiệu quả cửa hàng, daypart, delivery platform và CRM campaign; xác định nhóm khách hàng, khu vực hoặc occasion có tiềm năng tăng trưởng.
Sử dụng AI/NLP để xử lý dữ liệu phi cấu trúc như phản hồi khách hàng, CSAT, review, social listening, nội dung đối thủ và tài liệu nghiên cứu; xây dựng taxonomy, phân loại chủ đề, sentiment và trích xuất insight ở quy mô lớn.
Tổng hợp dữ liệu thị trường, xu hướng tiêu dùng và competitor intelligence để làm rõ vị thế của TCH và đề xuất cơ hội sản phẩm, giá, ưu đãi, kênh hoặc trải nghiệm mới.
Performance Reporting, Dashboard & Business Planning
Xây dựng và vận hành hệ thống báo cáo/dashboard phục vụ quản trị theo ngày, tuần, tháng và quý; đảm bảo người dùng có thể theo dõi đúng KPI ở đúng cấp độ chi tiết.
Chuẩn hóa logic đo lường, KPI dictionary và cách đối soát giữa các nguồn; duy trì single source of truth cho các chỉ số kinh doanh trọng yếu.
Chủ trì các báo cáo performance review và quarterly deep-dive; làm rõ “điều gì đã xảy ra – vì sao – tác động – cần làm gì tiếp theo” thay vì chỉ mô tả số liệu.
Hỗ trợ chu kỳ business planning thông qua dự báo, scenario analysis, target setting và business case cho các sáng kiến Growth/Marketing/CRM/Digital/Operations.
Thiết kế AI copilot/agent và workflow tự động hóa các báo cáo lặp lại, data QA, insight summary và cảnh báo bất thường; tạo quy trình có thể tái sử dụng, truy vết và bàn giao cho team thay vì xử lý thủ công từng lần.
Experimentation, Measurement & Commercial Impact
Xây dựng measurement framework và success metrics trước khi triển khai campaign, promotion, CRM journey, tính năng App/Web, thay đổi menu/giá hoặc sáng kiến vận hành.
Thiết kế và phân tích A/B test hoặc các phương pháp đo lường phù hợp như control group, pre-post và matched cohort; kiểm soát selection bias, seasonality và các yếu tố gây nhiễu.
Đo lường incremental revenue, incremental margin, ROI/ROAS, uplift, cannibalization và tác động đến retention/frequency để phân biệt tăng trưởng thực với dịch chuyển kênh hoặc khách hàng mua sớm hơn.
Sử dụng AI để hỗ trợ xây dựng giả thuyết, kiểm tra edge case, sinh code phân tích và diễn giải kết quả; không sử dụng kết luận do AI tạo ra khi chưa kiểm chứng bằng phương pháp thống kê và dữ liệu nguồn.
Theo dõi kết quả sau rollout, xác định điều kiện để scale/stop/iterate và cùng business owner chuyển kết luận phân tích thành hành động.
Xây dựng kho learning và benchmark để tái sử dụng kết quả thử nghiệm, tránh lặp lại các test không tạo giá trị.
AI-enabled Analytics, Data Quality, Governance & Partnership
Đóng vai trò AI expert cho mảng Data Analytics: chủ động cập nhật công cụ/model mới, đánh giá khả năng ứng dụng và chuyển thành use case thực tế cho Growth và các phòng ban liên quan.
Xây dựng và vận hành AI workflow/agent phục vụ truy vấn dữ liệu, làm sạch, phân loại, tóm tắt, phát hiện bất thường, tạo báo cáo và hỗ trợ ra quyết định; có khả năng sử dụng API, automation platform hoặc code khi cần.
Thiết lập tiêu chuẩn sử dụng AI an toàn và có kiểm soát: prompt/version management, evaluation set, human review, kiểm tra hallucination, reproducibility, quyền truy cập, PII và bảo mật dữ liệu khách hàng.
Sử dụng SQL để khai thác, kết nối và kiểm tra dữ liệu; phối hợp với Data Engineering/IT/Product/Finance và các bên sở hữu hệ thống để đảm bảo dữ liệu được thu thập đầy đủ, đúng logic và sẵn sàng cho phân tích.
Thiết lập quy trình data quality gồm reconciliation, anomaly monitoring, issue log và SLA xử lý; chủ động cảnh báo khi dữ liệu không đủ tin cậy để ra quyết định.
Tài liệu hóa nguồn dữ liệu, business logic, metric definition, dashboard/AI workflow ownership và các thay đổi ảnh hưởng đến báo cáo; bảo đảm khả năng truy vết và bàn giao.
Đóng vai trò data & AI consultant cho các team; đào tạo người dùng về data literacy, cách khai thác dashboard và cách sử dụng AI đúng mục đích, đúng dữ liệu và đúng giới hạn.
Tiếp nhận và ưu tiên yêu cầu phân tích dựa trên giá trị kinh doanh, tính cấp thiết và effort; thống nhất rõ câu hỏi, output, deadline và decision owner trước khi thực hiện.

YÊU CẦU

Học vấn và nền tảng:
Tốt nghiệp đại học chuyên ngành Phân tích dữ liệu, Thống kê, Toán, Kinh tế, Tài chính, Quản trị Kinh doanh, Marketing hoặc các ngành liên quan.
Kỹ năng:
AI expert trong công việc phân tích dữ liệu: sử dụng AI nhuần nhuyễn từ data discovery, cleaning, SQL/Python, EDA, modeling, visualization đến insight synthesis và storytelling; biết rõ khi nào cần và không nên dùng AI.
Có khả năng thiết kế workflow/AI agent có thể tái sử dụng bằng LLM, API, custom assistant hoặc automation platform; hiểu prompt engineering, context design, tool use, structured output và evaluation.
Có khả năng kiểm chứng code, công thức và kết luận do AI hỗ trợ; kiểm soát hallucination, data leakage, PII, quyền truy cập, reproducibility và audit trail.
Thành thạo SQL; có khả năng xử lý truy vấn phức tạp với joins, CTE, window functions và kiểm tra chất lượng dữ liệu.
Thành thạo Excel và ít nhất một công cụ BI/visualization như Power BI, Tableau hoặc Looker; có khả năng thiết kế dashboard rõ ràng, dễ sử dụng và phù hợp với nhu cầu ra quyết định.
Sử dụng được Python cho xử lý dữ liệu, automation và prototyping; có khả năng đọc, sửa, giải thích và chịu trách nhiệm về code dù được AI hỗ trợ.
Nắm vững thống kê ứng dụng, cohort/segmentation, forecasting và phương pháp đo lường thử nghiệm; hiểu sự khác biệt giữa correlation và causation.
Có tư duy thương mại, hiểu doanh thu, transaction, ticket size, margin, ROI và economics của promotion; ưu tiên hiểu mô hình F&B, retail, loyalty và omni-channel.
Có khả năng kết nối nhiều nguồn dữ liệu, xác định root cause và chuyển phân tích thành khuyến nghị cụ thể, có ưu tiên và có thể đo lường.
Kỹ năng giao tiếp, data storytelling và trình bày tốt; có khả năng điều chỉnh mức độ chi tiết theo đối tượng từ team vận hành đến lãnh đạo.
Kinh nghiệm:
Tối thiểu 4 năm kinh nghiệm trong Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Business/Consumer Insights hoặc vai trò tương đương; có track record biến phân tích thành quyết định và kết quả kinh doanh.
Bắt buộc có kinh nghiệm ứng dụng AI vào ít nhất một quy trình hoặc dự án phân tích dữ liệu thực tế, thể hiện được bài toán, cách triển khai, cơ chế kiểm chứng và tác động tạo ra.
Ưu tiên kinh nghiệm tại F&B, bán lẻ chuỗi, FMCG, thương mại điện tử hoặc doanh nghiệp có dữ liệu giao dịch và khách hàng quy mô lớn.
Ngoại ngữ:
Có khả năng đọc hiểu tài liệu chuyên môn, viết và trình bày bằng tiếng Anh trong môi trường công việc; giao tiếp rõ ràng với đối tác hoặc stakeholder nước ngoài khi cần.
Phẩm chất:
Chính trực – cam kết rõ ràng, nói A làm A; nếu có rủi ro không hoàn thành phải chủ động thông báo và đề xuất phương án khắc phục
Tận tâm/Customer First – bắt đầu từ nhu cầu của khách hàng và tác động thực tế đến trải nghiệm
100% về mình – ownership cao, theo việc đến cùng và chịu trách nhiệm về chất lượng đầu ra
Tò mò, tư duy phản biện và sẵn sàng challenge status quo bằng bằng chứng
Tư duy hệ thống, tỉ mỉ nhưng không sa đà; biết tập trung vào câu hỏi và quyết định quan trọng nhất
Hợp tác tốt, kiên định với dữ liệu nhưng linh hoạt trong cách làm việc với stakeholder

jobs.title: Business Intelligence Analyst
jobs.description:
Senior Business Intelligence Engineer (Power BI)
Experience level: 5+ years
Function: Data & Analytics / Business Intelligence
Engagement type: Client-facing delivery (consulting / embedded analytics)

About the Role
We're looking for a Senior BI Engineer who can own the full lifecycle of analytics delivery, from data modeling in the warehouse through to polished, secure, production-grade Power BI reporting embedded in client-facing applications. This is a hybrid technical and consultative role. You'll build the reports, engineer the data behind them, and communicate directly with client stakeholders about priorities, trade-offs, and progress.
You'll work on a mature analytics program spanning executive dashboards, member/partner performance reporting, geospatial analytics, embedded portal analytics, and emerging AI-driven conversational analytics. The right person is equally comfortable debugging a row-level security conflict in DAX, tuning a Snowflake view, and explaining a data limitation to a non-technical business owner in plain language.

Must-Have Qualifications
• 5+ years of hands-on BI/analytics engineering experience, with a strong concentration in Power BI.
• Expert-level DAX and Power Query / M, able to write, optimize, and debug complex measures and transformations.
• Strong data modeling fundamentals (star schema, relationships, cardinality, and their impact on report behavior).
• Deep, practical experience with row-level security in Power BI and its edge cases around export and embedding.
• Advanced SQL (required) and solid experience with a cloud data warehouse. Snowflake strongly preferred (or Redshift/BigQuery/Synapse with willingness to ramp on Snowflake).
• Python (required) for data work, including API integration, data prep/transformation, notebook-based workflows, and automation/scripting.
• Solid grasp of data warehousing and ELT/ETL concepts and best practices.
• Discipline around data validation, QA, and testing, plus awareness of data governance and sensitive/PII handling.
• Experience delivering in a client-facing or stakeholder-facing capacity: gathering requirements, managing expectations, and explaining technical concepts to non-technical audiences.

Self-starter who takes ownership and drives outcomes with minimal supervision.

Knowledge

jobs.description:
Project management of batteries refers to a series of management activities involving planning, organizing, implementing and controlling during the battery production process. Manage the planning, resource allocation, progress control, risk management, quality assurance and other aspects of battery projects. During the battery mass production stage, pay attention to and solve the construction situation of the production line, and respond to various audits and demand inquiries from customers.

Job responsibilities:

Project Plan: Determine the project's goals, scope, schedule, resource requirements, etc., formulate a detailed project plan, and identify the critical path and milestones.
Resource management: Effectively allocate and schedule the human, material, financial and other resources required for the project to ensure its smooth progress.
Risk management: Identify potential risks that the project may face and formulate corresponding response strategies to reduce the impact of project risks on schedule and cost.
Progress control: Supervise the progress of the project, adjust the plan in a timely manner, and ensure the project is completed on schedule.
Quality Management: Ensure that the battery products delivered for the project meet quality standards, take corresponding quality control measures, and supervise and evaluate the project quality.
Communication Management: Establish a sound communication mechanism to ensure effective communication among project team members and with relevant stakeholders, promoting the smooth progress of the project.

Job Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree or above in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Battery Engineering, Materials, Industrial Engineering or other related disciplines.
Fluent bilingual capability in both Chinese and English; capable of independently drafting project documents, holding online/offline customer audit meetings and daily business communication in English.
Solid full-cycle battery project management experience, familiar with new product introduction (NPI) and mass production delivery processes of power/energy storage batteries.
Able to travel moderately as required by project and customer needs.

new_jobs.title: Onboarding Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
What Makes Cloudbeds Unique

At Cloudbeds, we're not just building software, we’re transforming hospitality. Our intelligently designed platform powers properties across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From independent properties to hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've become the World's Best Hotel PMS Solutions Provider and landed on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again in 2024, but we're just getting started. 

How You'll Make an Impact:

As an Onboarding Project Manager

, you will lead complex onboarding projects for Cloudbeds’ mid-market customers, guiding them from contract signature through adoption and successful transition to Account Management at the time onboarding is completed. Acting as the strategic lead throughout the onboarding journey, you will partner cross-functionally with Onboarding, Account Management, Sales, Product, Support, Professional Services teams to deliver a seamless implementation experience that drives customer confidence, platform adoption, and measurable business outcomes.
You will play a critical role in ensuring customers realize value quickly by managing timelines, aligning stakeholders, mitigating risks, and maintaining a high-touch customer experience. This role combines project management, customer partnership and relationship management, operational excellence, and hospitality expertise in a fast-paced SaaS environment. You may be required to travel onsite within Thailand during the onboarding period when necessary to ensure the best possible customer experience and a clear understanding of the customer’s setup and desired outcomes
Our Onboarding Project Management Team:

Our team is passionate about delivering exceptional customer experiences and helping hoteliers succeed with Cloudbeds from day one. We build together, review opportunities together, and embrace a test-and-learn mindset that encourages innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Every team member is valued and empowered to share feedback, ideas, and insights so we can learn, grow, and improve both as individuals and as a team. Team members who thrive here are proactive communicators, collaborative problem-solvers, and true customer advocates who enjoy navigating complexity while working closely with others to drive successful outcomes.
What You Bring to the Team:

Own and manage the end-to-end onboarding lifecycle for mid-market customers, from sales handoff through go-live, adoption, and transition to Account Management
Define project scope, timelines, milestones, and deliverables to ensure successful and timely implementations
Serve as the primary point of contact for onboarding mid market customers, driving clear communication and stakeholder alignment throughout the project lifecycle
Lead customer meetings including pre-kickoff, kickoff, project check ins, and go-live milestones while documenting action items and next steps
Proactively identify and manage risks, dependencies, and escalation points to maintain project momentum and customer satisfaction
Coordinate cross-functional collaboration across Sales, Onboarding, Product, Support, Professional Services, and Account Management teams
Monitor onboarding success metrics, customer adoption, training completion, and utilization milestones to support long-term customer success

new_jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Project Manager EMEA based in Ireland.

As a Project Manager EMEA, you will lead complex client projects across a fast-growing global business messaging environment.

You will own enterprise client onboarding from initial setup through technical integration and campaign execution.

The role combines project management, stakeholder coordination, technical problem-solving, and customer relationship management.

You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Support teams to keep projects moving and resolve issues efficiently.

Your work will directly contribute to successful customer launches, reliable messaging campaigns, and scalable operational processes.

This is an opportunity to influence how businesses adopt messaging technology while working with international clients and distributed teams.

The position is fully remote and suited to an organized, independent professional who thrives in a fast-paced and evolving environment.

Accountabilities

Lead enterprise client onboarding end-to-end, including WhatsApp Business Account setup, phone number registration, template approvals, and technical integrations with APIs and CRM platforms such as Salesforce.
Plan, coordinate, and manage WhatsApp campaign sendouts, including template classification, scheduling, monitoring, and delivery troubleshooting.
Serve as the primary project contact for a portfolio of enterprise clients, leading status meetings, coordinating expectations, and managing escalations.
Coordinate cross-functional activities with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Support teams to resolve technical and operational issues and maintain project momentum.
Manage multiple concurrent projects and clients, balancing competing priorities, deadlines, and stakeholder requirements.
Maintain accurate project documentation, timelines, milestones, status updates, and performance tracking.
Define, monitor, and communicate relevant project KPIs, timelines, risks, and progress.
Identify process gaps and opportunities for improvement, contributing to scalable onboarding and campaign execution playbooks.
Proactively identify risks and blockers and take ownership of resolving issues or securing the appropriate internal support.
Build efficient, repeatable processes that improve the customer experience and support the organization’s continued growth.

Requirements

3+ years of project management experience, ideally within SaaS, martech, B2B technology, or another fast-paced digital environment.
Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent projects or enterprise clients while handling competing priorities and deadlines.
Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to align internal teams and external clients around objectives, timelines, and deliverables.
Solid understanding of project management methodologies, including Agile/Scrum, Waterfall, or hybrid approaches.
Comfortable working with project management and tracking tools and maintaining structured project documentation.
Data-driven mindset with the ability to define, monitor, analyze, and report on project KPIs and timelines.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; additional languages such as Russian, Spanish, or Portuguese are an advantage.
Familiarity with the WhatsApp Business API, Meta Business ecosystem, messaging platforms, or CRM technologies is a plus.
Understanding of B2B client onboarding, technical integrations, campaign implementation, or marketing funnel processes is advantageous.
Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage several workstreams independently.
Practical problem-solving approach with a strong bias toward action and ownership.
Comfortable working autonomously in a fast-paced, continuously evolving product and technology environment.
Demonstrated willingness to learn, share knowledge, take responsibility, and contribute to the development of scalable processes and solutions.

Benefits

€3,000–€3,500 per month, depending on experience, seniority, and fit with the role requirements.
Fully remote, contract-based position with the flexibility to work from anywhere in the world.
Opportunity to work in a global, technology-driven environment focused on the rapidly evolving business messaging industry.
Collaboration with experienced technology and business professionals across an international, distributed organization.
Significant opportunities for professional growth, learning, and exposure to SaaS, messaging technology, enterprise client management, and technical project delivery.
Opportunity to take ownership of impactful projects and contribute ideas to improve products, processes, and customer experiences.
Dynamic environment that encourages independent thinking, continuous learning, responsibility, and scalable solutions.
Competitive compensation designed to reflect skills, experience, and achievements.

How Jobgether Works

We use an AI-powered matching process
to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Working closely with Product, Services, Customer Support, Learning, and Knowledge Management teams, the Content Solutions Project Manager drives end-to-end execution of content projects, from planning and stakeholder alignment through implementation, measurement, and optimization. The successful candidate combines strong project management expertise with a deep understanding of content operations, knowledge management, content technologies, analytics, and AI-enabled content solutions.

Project Leadership & Delivery

Lead multiple concurrent content initiatives and strategic programs, ensuring successful delivery within scope, schedule, and quality expectations.
Develop and maintain project plans, timelines, dependencies, milestones, and status reporting for content-focused initiatives.

Lead initiatives involving content migration, content lifecycle management, content governance, AI-enabled content programs, and knowledge platform enhancements.

Measurement & Continuous Improvement

Define success metrics and measure project outcomes using content analytics, adoption metrics, user feedback, and business KPIs.
Monitor content performance trends and identify opportunities for optimization.
Develop executive-ready reports and dashboards communicating project status, outcomes, and value realization.
Contribute to the evolution of content governance, project management methodologies, tools, templates, and best practices.

Experience with process improvement, workflow optimization, and change management methodologies.

ASC is Australia’s submarine company. We built the Royal Australian Navy’s Collins Class submarines, sustain them, and are now delivering their Life of Type Extension to increase the boats’ service lives. We have also been selected by the Australian Government to sustain and jointly build the nation’s nuclear-powered submarines - the largest and most complex industrial undertaking in Australia’s history.
Our work is interesting and meaningful, contributing directly to Australia’s national security. We offer rewarding roles that provide the opportunity to grow your career, and the flexibility to balance life and work. A career at ASC is like no other, delivering a deeper purpose we can all be proud of.

About the Opportunity

We’re looking for a dynamic Assistant Project Manager to support the planning, execution, and reporting of our diverse project portfolio in the Innovation, Science & Technology Program. Working closely with the Innovation, Science & Technology Project Manager and a collaborative team, you’ll play a key role in shaping the future of innovation across the organisation.
Responsibilities

Support the delivery of innovation, science and technology initiatives from concept through to implementation and handover.

Assist in the development of project plans, roadmaps and business cases that support emerging technologies and strategic innovation priorities.

Monitor project progress, schedules, budgets, risks and outcomes to ensure successful delivery and value for investment.

Evaluate innovation opportunities and support feasibility assessments, business case development and project prioritisation activities.

Build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders across the business, industry, academia and government.

Prepare project reports, presentations and governance documentation to support effective decision-making.

Contribute to project governance, frameworks and continuous improvement initiatives that enhance project delivery and innovation capability.

Support portfolio management activities, ensuring projects remain aligned with business objectives and strategic priorities.

Provide day-to-day project coordination and support to the broader Innovation & Improvement team.

About you

Tertiary qualifications in Project Management, Engineering, Business or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.

2-3 years' experience in a Project Coordinator, Assistant Project Manager, Project Support or similar role.

Experience supporting project planning, scheduling, reporting, governance and risk management activities.

Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to work effectively across multidisciplinary teams.

The ability to manage competing priorities and coordinate multiple project activities simultaneously.

Experience preparing project documentation, presentations, reports and project updates for stakeholders.

Strong analytical and organisational skills, with proficiency in Microsoft Excel and experience using project management or reporting tools.

A proactive mindset with a passion for innovation, continuous improvement and problem-solving.

Eligibility

This role requires a current National Police Clearance and an Australian Defence Security Clearance. Your eligibility for this role is dependent on you obtaining and maintaining such clearance.
To check your eligibility please visit the Australian Government Security Vetting Agency website.

Benefits

Unique and challenging work with a deeper purpose.

Flexibility over how, when and where you work for the best work/life balance.

Up to 10 days additional leave every year so you can rest and recharge.

Generous parental leave so you can give your family the focus it deserves.

Subsidised childcare to ease the financial pressure on your family.

Health and wellbeing initiatives so you can perform at your best at work.

Professional development opportunities to advance your career.

A diverse and supportive environment where you can thrive.

Discounts and exclusive offers from leading Australian brands to help you save.

ASC’s 3,000-plus staff offer a depth of submarine design, project management, supply chain, construction and engineering experience and expertise that is unparalleled in Australia’s defence industry. Established in 1985, the company’s work on Australia’s conventionally armed, nuclear-powered submarine build and the Collins Class Life of Type Extension takes place in Osborne, South Australia, with sustainment shared across Osborne and Henderson, Western Australia. ASC also plays a leading role in training Royal Australian Navy submariners.

About the Role

Delticom is looking for a Project Manager - Logistics, Process Optimization & AI Automation to support the continuous improvement and digitalisation of our European e-commerce operations.
The role sits at the intersection of logistics, supply chain, business processes and AI-enabled automation.
You will work closely with Operations, Logistics, Purchasing, IT and other business functions to analyse existing processes, identify improvement opportunities and manage projects from initial concept through implementation.
A particular focus of the role is the practical use of AI and automation. We are looking for someone who understands operational processes and is comfortable using modern AI tools to improve workflows, reporting, decision-making and efficiency.
This is a hands-on project-management role. You do not need to be a software developer or a senior supply-chain executive. You should, however, understand logistics and operational processes well enough to identify problems, structure solutions and work with technical teams to implement them.

Your Responsibilities

Manage operational improvement and digitalisation projects across logistics, warehousing, transport, supply chain, purchasing and related business processes.
Analyse existing workflows and identify bottlenecks, manual activities and opportunities for optimisation.
Work with operational teams to define requirements and translate them into clear project plans and implementation steps.
Coordinate projects involving internal departments, logistics providers, suppliers and technology partners.
Support the optimisation of warehousing and fulfilment, transportation and carrier management, inventory and product availability, purchasing and supplier processes, demand and capacity planning, and operational reporting and KPI management.
Identify opportunities to use AI, automation and data-driven tools to reduce manual work and improve operational performance.
Prototype and test AI-assisted workflows using LLMs, AI agents, automation platforms and APIs.
Work with IT, developers and external partners to move successful prototypes into reliable business processes.
Create process documentation, business requirements, SOPs, workflows and project documentation.
Monitor project progress, risks, timelines and dependencies.
Define KPIs and measure the operational impact of implemented improvements.
Support management with analyses, reporting and recommendations.
Participate in cross-functional and international projects across Delticom's European operations.

What We Are Looking For

Approximately 2-4 years of professional experience in project management, logistics, supply chain, operations, process management, e-commerce or a comparable field.
Practical understanding of logistics and operational processes.
Experience managing improvement, digitalisation or automation projects.
Experience working with warehouses, transportation, inventory, purchasing, suppliers or fulfilment processes is highly desirable.
Experience in e-commerce, online retail or another order-to-delivery environment is a strong advantage.
Ability to analyse processes, identify problems and structure practical solutions.
Strong project-management and stakeholder-management skills.
Comfortable working with operational and technical teams.
Good understanding of KPIs, process performance and operational reporting.
Hands-on interest in AI and automation.
Experience using modern AI tools such as Zed, Cursor, ChatGPT, Claude, or similar solutions.
Ability to understand APIs, workflows, integrations and technical documentation at a functional level.
Good analytical skills and confidence working with data.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Professional English. German is highly desirable.
Willingness to work on-site in Hannover.

AI & Automation Experience

You do not need to be an AI engineer. We are looking for someone who is comfortable experimenting with technology and can use AI to solve practical operational problems.
Relevant experience could include:
LLMs and generative AI; prompt engineering; AI agents and AI-assisted workflows.
Power Automate, n8n, Make, UiPath or similar automation platforms.
Process mining, Python, SQL, REST APIs or webhooks.
Power BI or similar analytics tools.
ERP, WMS or TMS systems and low-code/no-code platforms.
AI-assisted coding tools such as Zed, Cursor, or similar.

Experience with every technology listed above is not required. What matters is the ability to learn quickly and apply technology to real operational problems.
Your Profile
You enjoy understanding how processes actually work.
When you see a repetitive manual task, an inefficient handover or an operational bottleneck, your first reaction is to understand the root cause and look for a better solution.
You are comfortable speaking with warehouse, logistics, purchasing and business teams, but you can also work effectively with IT, developers and technology providers.
You do not simply create PowerPoint recommendations. You like taking responsibility for implementation, testing whether a solution works, and improving it based on real-world results.
You are curious about AI and already use modern AI tools in your work. At the same time, you understand that technology is only valuable when it solves a genuine business problem.
Particularly Relevant Backgrounds

We would be especially interested in candidates with experience in:

e-commerce or online retail;
logistics or fulfilment companies;
automotive or spare-parts distribution;
retail supply chains;
3PL or transportation organisations;
supply-chain consulting;
operational excellence or process improvement;
ERP/WMS/TMS implementation;
digitalisation or automation projects.

Experience in the tyre or automotive sector is helpful, but not required.
What Success Looks Like

Within your first year, we would expect you to have:

successfully delivered several operational improvement projects;
automated selected manual processes;
improved transparency through better KPIs and reporting;
identified and implemented practical AI use cases;
reduced unnecessary operational effort or process complexity;
improved collaboration between Operations and IT;
developed a strong understanding of Delticom's European logistics and supply-chain processes; and
created measurable improvements in cost, speed, quality or reliability.

If you have experience in logistics or operational processes, enjoy managing implementation projects and want to apply AI and automation to real business challenges, we would like to hear from you.
